Interface GameView

All Known Implementing Classes:
J2dGame
public interface GameView
Abstraction for the visualization layer, used by Game to render and read input without depending on any specific graphics library (Java2D, OpenGL, etc.).

J2dGame implements this interface. The Game class only ever sees GameView, never the concrete J2d classes — this enforces the game/visualization separation. The game loop in Game.start() calls render() once per frame and queries input state through the other methods.

The was...Pressed() / wasMouseClicked() methods follow a consume-once pattern: they return true exactly once after the event occurs, then reset to false.
